issues.decision: Replace the twelve-year forum and reseller transmission-failure aggregation with recall 04V-021's exact 1995-1999 ignition-park interlock condition and rollaway remedy.

evidence.label: NHTSA Recall 04V-021 - Floor-Shifter Interlock Rollaway Risk

trims: Vehicles included in recall C45/04V-021; verify by VIN
after.title: Floor-Shifter Interlock Failure Can Allow Vehicle Rollaway (Recall 04V-021)
after.description: NHTSA recall 04V-021 covers certain 1995-1999 Dodge Intrepid vehicles. The ignition-park interlock can fail, allowing the shifter to move out of Park with the key removed or allowing the key to be removed when the transmission is not in Park. Either condition can allow an unattended vehicle to roll away.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall 04V-021. DaimlerChrysler's remedy is installation of a new load-limiting push rod in the floor-shifter lever. Until verified and repaired, positively confirm Park and apply the parking brake before leaving the vehicle.
symptoms: Shifter can move out of Park after the key is removed
Ignition key can be removed while the shifter is not in Park
Vehicle may roll away without warning

citations.title: NHTSA Recall 04V-021 - Floor-Shifter Interlock Rollaway Risk

after.contentUpdateSummary: Replaced the twelve-year generic transmission-failure aggregation with recall 04V-021's exact 1995-1999 interlock failure, rollaway risk, and shifter push-rod remedy.
